stone-charcoal.$description: Stone Charcoal — Primary text, navigation links, hairline borders, footer anchors — dark warm gray carries the same temperature as the cream surfaces it sits on, never pure black

linen-cream.$description: Linen Cream — Heading text, footer surface, and the lighter plane in the surface stack — sits one step above the canvas

warm-sand.$description: Warm Sand — Page canvas — the dominant field every section and hero lives on

dust.$description: Dust — Secondary borders and dividers when Stone Charcoal would be too heavy

mortar.$description: Mortar — Muted body text and subdued borders — the quietest readable neutral

basis.$description: Body, nav, labels, captions — the only text family used for everything below display. The 0.066–0.099em tracking on 10–14px is the signature: it makes small text feel like a printed catalogue label rather than screen UI.

favorit.$description: Display and heading — set at a single 30px size, weight 400 only. The narrow, slightly quirky character shapes (open apertures, subtle inktraps) carry all the personality the system allows. No bold weight exists.
